oai_searchbot_check.conclusion: ZERO stores block OAI-SearchBot. 2 stores (TSP, JDMuscle) explicitly allow it. 8 stores (including Subimods) have no OAI-SearchBot rule, meaning the default User-agent: * applies — which does NOT block crawling of product pages. Subimods' invisibility in the Catalog is NOT caused by robots.txt blocking OAI-SearchBot. The cause must be elsewhere (e.g., Catalog ingestion pipeline, product data format, or store-level Catalog opt-in).
